_note: Run scripts\update_mod_browser.ps1 to refresh stamp, version, zip, bytes, sha, sha256, keys, requires, loadAfter, preset, defaultOff and alwaysOn. Edit icon, category, summary and details by hand, then copy stamp to checked. category is one of Scenes, Gameplay, Maps, Visual, Tools.

mods.title: Admin Panel
mods.summary: Cheat panel opened from a button in the pause menu.
mods.details: Adds an Admin Panel button to the pause menu. The panel holds cheats and the settings for other mods, such as the Enemy Randomizer and a button to enter the Backrooms. Esc closes it. It also works with a controller: the pause menu's highlight reaches the button and A opens it, then the D-pad or left stick moves, left and right change a setting, A selects, B goes back and Start closes. The controller needs ModKit 1.1.0, from the newest patch, and was tested in game with a virtual Xbox controller.

mods.title: Enemy Randomizer
mods.summary: Any regular enemy can appear at any spawn point on any floor.
mods.details: Shuffles which enemies appear in the dungeon. Each enemy gets a spawn percent, and spawn points can be left empty. Set it up in the Admin Panel or in mod-randomizer.json, which is read at launch.

mods.title: Backrooms
mods.summary: A door to a Backrooms dungeon of 3 to 10 floors, built like the game's own dungeons.
mods.details: A door in the Starting Hall and in Free Mode leads to the Lobby, the Backrooms' starting zone. Each visit, the game's own dungeon builder puts together 3 to 10 floors out of Backrooms rooms, behind the game's loading screen and its floor-by-floor loading sequence. As in the game's dungeons, travel doors join the floors, some exits stay locked until you find that floor's obsidian key, and the map shows each floor. Smilers, Mannequins and Lost Souls roam the floors, with ammo to find. A door in the Lobby and the last floor's door lead back out. The Admin Panel can also send you there. Not included with the patch; get it from the Get Mods tab.

mods.title: Monitor Setting
mods.summary: Adds a Monitor row to the video settings.
mods.details: Pick which monitor the game shows on from the game's own video settings, for setups with more than one screen.

mods.title: Plant Distractor
mods.summary: Plant pairs placed in each level as a distraction.
mods.details: Places a pair of plants somewhere in each level, picking a random kind of scene each time. Includes a volume slider in the settings menu. Its sounds are also used by Crab Pair.

mods.title: Crab Pair
mods.summary: A pair of headcrabs as a distraction, plus a rare plant scene.
mods.details: Two headcrabs paired up as a distraction, like the plants. Now and then a mouth plant appears with a headcrab instead. Silent without Plant Distractor, whose sounds it uses.

mods.title: Ghost Kiss
mods.summary: Lost Souls sometimes pair up and kiss.
mods.details: Each Lost Soul has a chance to gain a partner and start kissing, and the pair stays facing each other. They ignore you until you get close or hurt one. A kissing pair shows the game's own prompt: hold Interact and, with enough lust, you grab both heads for a double scene. Played to the end it finishes like the game's own scenes: with the Purification perk both are purified, and without it they go back to kissing. Interact again lets go early, with E or the controller's Interact button (the controller needs ModKit 1.1.0). A single Lost Soul also gets a Neck scene in the game's own scene lists, beside its blowjob: switch to it with D in Free Mode, or pick it from the Sex scenes on the wheel. The game runs it like its own, with its stages and climax bar. The double scene has only been tested without graphics.

mods.title: ModKit
mods.summary: Shared code the other mods rely on.
mods.details: Logging, safe loops and keys, messages between mods, settings menu sliders, and a Pad module that lets mods read controller buttons. Since 1.1.0 the controller can reach and move the settings menu sliders. Always on, and comes with the patch. To update it, run the newest patch again.

mods.title: Gooner DLC
mods.summary: Twisted Nurse variations, 74 extra pair animations, 33 new player scenes, Freecam, a Free Mode scene picker and a Boss Timer switch, in one mod.
mods.details: Some Twisted Nurses are found touching themselves until woken, some are futa, and some appear in pairs: groping, snuggling, from behind, riding, kissing, the Banshee's Behind and Carry scenes, or one of 74 extra pair animations. The player gets Kiss From Behind and 33 new scenes with the Twisted, Twisted Nurse and Witness: a 50% chance in dungeons, set in the Admin Panel, and always in their Free Mode scene lists. In any sex scene, the Perspective key (middle mouse, or the right stick click) now goes first person, third person, then Freecam: fly with WASD and the mouse or the sticks, Space/Ctrl or RB/LB for up and down, Shift or LT faster; the next press puts the camera back. In a Free Mode scene list, Tab (Y on a controller) opens a list of every scene to click straight to one, shown by a Tab prompt above Next Stage. The Admin Panel's Gooner DLC tab has a Boss Timer setting: Off stops the countdown before a dungeon's stalker boss arrives, so it never comes (a boss already there stays), and hides the countdown. It is remembered between launches and has only been tested without graphics. It contains Nurse Touch, so don't run the separate Nurse Touch mod as well. Also gives other mods the AnimationsPlus animation library. The extra animations are retargeted from the OLL Animations (AP) pack for WickedWhims. Not included with the patch; get it from the Get Mods tab.
